title: The Cadaver in the Machine: The Social Practices of Measurement and Validation in Motion Capture Technology
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. It is a systematic literature review and analysis of motion capture technology.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the social practices of measurement and validation in motion capture technology, and the historical assumptions about human bodies (e.g., race, sex, ability) embedded within these systems.
